E1.配方: 0.5 M LiTFSI + 3 M LiNO3，二甘醇二甲醚

C1.原句: Li was deposited onto Cu at 0.4 mA/cm2 to a 1 mAh/cm2 deposition capacity, then stripped at 0.4 mA/cm2 to a voltage cut-oﬀof 1 V.

C2.原句: S4, Li//Li cells were cycled at 0.5 mA/cm2 to a capacity of 5 mAh/cm2 (C/10 rate).

C3.正极: MWCNT/PTFE 碳电极 + 溶液正极（Li2S8 2 M[S]）
C3.原句: The Li-S cell was cycled at 0.4 mA/ cm2 (200 mA/g) between 1.9 and 2.7 V which is approximately C/7 rate.

指标.原句: By increasing the con- centration of LiNO3 by tenfold in the new electrolyte, Li can be cycled for > 200 cycles at > 99% CE.
Only about 20% of the deposited Li is suc- cessfully stripped in the 1 M LiTFSI/G2 during each cycle and the re- mainder is built up as dead Li.
Astonishingly, however, the G2-based electrolyte containing a high concentration of LiNO3 (3 M) cycled for over 3000 h and only began to show a very slight increase in the polarization after 2800 h.
When LiNO3 is used as an additive in small quantities (0.3 M), the cycle life is extended substantially from ~ 500 to ~ 1400 h.

备注: Li–S 电池（C3，溶液正极）只测了 E1 一种电解液：第 2 圈 1349 → 第 100 圈 1215 mAh g-1；全电池层面没有配方比较，配方比较都在 Cu‖Li、Li‖Li。B 步判 Ⅰ 合格偏宽；且实际是溶液正极，主层归属待核。
